content: For single-model low-QPS (<10 req/s) serving, plain FastAPI + ultralytics YOLO() loaded once at startup (thread-safe init) is recommended over TorchServe; TorchServe/Triton only pay off at high throughput (>1000 req/s) or multi-model GPU batching. CPU inference: export to ONNX + onnxruntime for lower memory/faster CPU inference; GPU: TensorRT export for max throughput. Keep both .pt (dev/testing) and .onnx (deployment) artifacts.
